description: Query Ahrefs backlinks, keyword, rank tracking, site audit, and SERP data from the terminal.

novel_features.name: Crawler IP allowlist lookup
novel_features.description: Return Ahrefs crawler IP addresses without requiring an Ahrefs API key.

novel_features.name: Crawler CIDR range lookup
novel_features.description: Return Ahrefs crawler IP ranges without requiring an Ahrefs API key.

novel_features.name: API usage and limit check
novel_features.description: Inspect Ahrefs API subscription limits and usage through the documented v3 endpoint.

novel_features.name: Backlink profile snapshot
novel_features.description: Fetch point-in-time backlink metrics for a target from Ahrefs Site Explorer.

novel_features.name: Keyword volume by country
novel_features.description: Compare keyword search volume across countries from Ahrefs Keywords Explorer.

novel_features.name: Competitor keyword gap
novel_features.description: Compare Site Explorer organic-keyword rows across your target and competitors to find competitor rankings you lack or rank worse for.

novel_features.name: Striking-distance keywords
novel_features.description: Find organic keywords ranking in positions 4 through 15 and sort them by volume-weighted opportunity.

novel_features.name: Competitor link intersect
novel_features.description: Derive referring domains from Site Explorer backlink rows and find domains linking competitors but not your target.

novel_features.name: Site Explorer snapshot
novel_features.description: Combine domain rating, backlink stats, and organic/paid metrics into a partial-failure-tolerant report card.
